channel.title: Dutton Brown Product Feed — Google Shopping (US)
channel.description: Modern lighting and hardware, made to order in Minneapolis.

item.title: Cap Modern Globe Pendant 8" Lighting Nickel | Dutton Brown
item.description: Meet the Cap Pendant 8" – your high-end cure for the common cord set. This small but mighty globe pendant brings all the mid-century vibes with none of the nonsense. Its hand-blown opal glass and solid brass construction give it a luxe feel, while the solid rod mount keeps it looking sharp and secure (no flimsy, floppy cords here). Let it hang solo to brighten up a corner or in multiples for added drama. Line it in kitchens, hallways, bathrooms, and any space in need of soft, flattering light. Because every room deserves a glow-up.

item.title: Cap Modern Globe Wall Sconce 6" Lighting Brass | Dutton Brown
item.description: The Cap Globe Sconce 6" is a timeless, mid-century wall sconce crafted from high-end solid brass parts. Quality polished, lacquered metal or powder-coated finishes ensure a long-lasting fixture for your home. The fixture's seamless cap and exclusive globe holder are designed to flawlessly form onto the hand-blown glass globe. Create a cohesive look in your space with this luxe design. This style is present in many of our other sconces, pendants and chandeliers in the store. Each fixture can be positioned up or down to create the kind of ambiance you deserve without breaking the bank.

item.title: Crown Modern Globe Chandelier 32" Lighting Brass | Dutton Brown
item.description: The Crown Globe Chandelier 32" is a luxe statement chandelier in the form of a vortex of high-end finishes and globes. This light fixture is also perfect for a variety of styles and spaces. The globe chandelier's circular shape is perfect above circular and square tables, and the light fixture is flat enough still that it can be installed flush up near the ceiling revealing the beautiful, star-like pattern created by the fixture's arms.

item.title: Crown Modern Globe Flush Mount 32" Lighting Brass | Dutton Brown
item.description: The Crown Globe Flush Mount 32" is a beautiful set of nested arms splitting into one of 10 globes of light. The perfect lighting for spaces with lower ceilings, the fixture is also great in rooms with 8ft ceilings when a bit of extra headroom is necessary. Want to hang over a table or have higher ceilings? This globe lighting is also available as the Crown Globe Chandelier.

item.title: Crown Modern Globe Chandelier 46" Lighting Brass | Dutton Brown
item.description: The Crown Globe Chandelier 46" is one of our largest chandeliers and is a structured beauty with its vortex of nested globes. This globe chandelier features 5 arms, each with two 8" globes branching out in a Y-shape tilted diagonally giving the fixture a captivating view from every angle. Its circular shape is perfect above large circular and square tables, and the light fixture is flat enough still that it can be installed flush up near the ceiling revealing the beautiful, star-like pattern created by the fixture's arms.

item.title: Color Elliptical Sputnik Modern Flush Mount Lighting Brass + White | Dutton Brown
item.description: This Elliptical Sputnik Flush Mount is the ultimate colorful lighting statement piece for thoroughfares and rooms with lower ceilings. From the side the fixture takes on a wide elliptical shape that from below is revealed to be completely round with each of its 18 sockets oriented on varied arms lengths exiting laterally from the core. Also available is our Sputnik Chandelier for taller spaces.

item.title: Color Beaded Urchin Modern Flush Mount 27" Lighting Brass + White | Dutton Brown
item.description: Our color beaded "urchin" is the ultimate combination of captivating design and colorful charm. Each flush mount is built on a CNC-machined aluminum core adorned with 316 individually threaded solid brass rods. What makes this fixture special though are its 124 colorful beads, all powder coated here in-house, that create an explosive supernova effect. Choose from our array of colors or a custom color and learn why our customers oft call this "my urchin".

item.title: Bling Modern Pendant Lighting Brass | Dutton Brown
item.description: Our laser-cut acrylic Bling Pendant captures light in a way that must be seen to be believed. This fixture showcases our interpretation of modern minimalism via its two concentric high-clarity acrylic discs that catch the light just right. This sleek pendant light works solo to highlight a powder room, your makeup vanity, or in multiples to make a bold statement above your kitchen island, dining table, or down a dramatic runway (some call them hallways). It’s the perfect finishing touch for spaces that crave a little glamour.

item.title: Color Cadbury Modern Pendant 10" Lighting Brass + White | Dutton Brown
item.description: Our Color Cadbury Pendant 10" is the dome pendant born after we'd seen one too many tragically hung low-gauge dome pendants on crooked fabric cords. The solution? Cover the cord with a solid brass rod, integrate a seamless cap atop each dome, and source aluminum domes thick enough that they don't sound like empty soda cans when you tap them. Alike all our lighting, this pendant is basically a masterclass in how to do lighting the right way. And with “Cadbury” meaning “strong fortress” in Celtic, this fixture is literally built on bold foundations. Pop a pair above your kitchen island or flank your vanity for a look that says, “Yes, I have great taste. Thanks for noticing.”

The wall sconce's dome is topped off with a seamless cap of brass, nickel, or black mirroring the fixture's backplate and elevating the sconce as well as the room. Each fixture is constructed from exclusively designed parts crafted from high-gauge solid brass. Position this wall sconce down to direct light over a beautiful piece of art or turn it up to diffuse light off the walls and ceiling. We also offer a similar style fixture as a pendant or flush mount.

item.title: Color Cadbury Modern Wall Sconce 10" Lighting Brass + White | Dutton Brown
item.description: "Cadbury" means strong fortress in Celtic, and this sconce doesn't let you forget it. Built from high-gauge aluminum and solid brass with a solid dome shade, the Color Cadbury Sconce 10" is engineered to hold its ground, good for reading light beside a bed, focused task lighting over a desk, or a warm downward glow in a hallway or entryway. Choose from 14 signature colors and brass, nickel, or black finishes to make any space your own stronghold. At Dutton Brown, we think every fortress needs a little flair.

item.title: Color Cadbury Modern Pendant 8" Lighting Brass + White | Dutton Brown
item.description: Our Color Cadbury Pendant 8" is the dome pendant born after we'd seen one too many tragically hung low-gauge dome pendants on crooked fabric cords. The solution? Cover the cord with a solid brass rod, integrate a seamless cap atop each dome, and source aluminum domes thick enough that they don't sound like flimsy cans when you tap them. Alike all our lighting, this pendant is basically a masterclass in how to do lighting design the right way. And with “Cadbury” meaning “strong fortress” in Celtic, this fixture is literally built on bold foundations. Pop a pair above your kitchen island or flank your vanity for a look that says, “Yes, I have great taste. Thanks for noticing.”

item.title: Color Reader Modern Pendant Lighting Brass + White | Dutton Brown
item.description: The library is open. Up first: Color Reader Pendant. Whether you need this pendant to light up the werkroom with multiples or just need one to illuminate your beauty corner, the Color Reader Pendant's tucked reflector-style bulb directs light downwards, eliminating distracting glare. Choose from 13 color options and 3 finishes to bring your space's story to life –– we suggest Orange and Nickel for our comedy queens or Barely and Brass for our pageant queens. Because reading is what? Fundamental.

item.title: Color Eureka Modern Pendant Lighting Brass + White | Dutton Brown
item.description: Eureka - you've found it! A fixture designed to help you discover (if you didn't know already) that you're a minimalist. The Color Eureka Pendant is the light your space has been waiting for. Combining modern minimalist design with customizable style, this cute fixture creates that joyous “aha moment” every time you flip the switch. Handcrafted from high-quality materials, this ceiling pendant offers permanence that corded drop lights can only dream of. No flimsy wires here. Choose from 13 powder-coated color options to match your kitchen island countertops, dining room wallpaper, or inside a walk-in closet. Whether you’re adding one for a focused glow or installing multiples for dramatic impact, Eureka was designed to help you discover your style... and your keys.

item.title: Color Cadbury Modern Pendant 8" Lighting Brass + Slate Blue | Dutton Brown
item.description: Our Color Cadbury Pendant 8" is the dome pendant born after we'd seen one too many tragically hung low-gauge dome pendants on crooked fabric cords. The solution? Cover the cord with a solid brass rod, integrate a seamless cap atop each dome, and source aluminum domes thick enough that they don't sound like flimsy cans when you tap them. Alike all our lighting, this pendant is basically a masterclass in how to do lighting design the right way. And with “Cadbury” meaning “strong fortress” in Celtic, this fixture is literally built on bold foundations. Pop a pair above your kitchen island or flank your vanity for a look that says, “Yes, I have great taste. Thanks for noticing.”

item.title: Color Echo Modern Pendant 8" Lighting Brass + Slate Blue | Dutton Brown
item.description: The Color Echo Pendant 8" is so cute you'll hear compliments over and over almost like there's... an echo. With its bold, colorful dome and its inverted curved cap, this pendant brings playful energy and upbeat style to any space. Solid brass hardware and powder-coated finishes give it a luxurious edge, while its silhouette shows your space (and you) deserves something a bit more than basic dome shade lighting. So go ahead and hang one or keep the look going with doubles or triples because we believe good design deserves to be repeated – line up two or three above a kitchen island, bar, or vanity for lighting that resonates.

This fixture showcases our interpretation of modern minimalism via its two concentric high-clarity acrylic discs that catch the light just right. This sleek pendant light works solo to highlight a powder room, your makeup vanity, or in multiples to make a bold statement above your kitchen island, dining table, or down a dramatic runway (some call them hallways). No matter which color and finish you choose your ceilings are destined to shine. It’s the perfect finishing touch for spaces that crave a little glamour.

item.title: Crown Modern Globe Chandelier 32" Lighting Black | Dutton Brown
item.description: The Crown Globe Chandelier 32" is a luxe statement chandelier in the form of a vortex of high-end finishes and globes. This light fixture is also perfect for a variety of styles and spaces. The globe chandelier's circular shape is perfect above circular and square tables, and the light fixture is flat enough still that it can be installed flush up near the ceiling revealing the beautiful, star-like pattern created by the fixture's arms.

item.title: Crown Modern Globe Flush Mount 32" Lighting Black | Dutton Brown
item.description: The Crown Globe Flush Mount 32" is a beautiful set of nested arms splitting into one of 10 globes of light. The perfect lighting for spaces with lower ceilings, the fixture is also great in rooms with 8ft ceilings when a bit of extra headroom is necessary. Want to hang over a table or have higher ceilings? This globe lighting is also available as the Crown Globe Chandelier.

item.title: Crown Modern Globe Chandelier 46" Lighting Black | Dutton Brown
item.description: The Crown Globe Chandelier 46" is one of our largest chandeliers and is a structured beauty with its vortex of nested globes. This globe chandelier features 5 arms, each with two 8" globes branching out in a Y-shape tilted diagonally giving the fixture a captivating view from every angle. Its circular shape is perfect above large circular and square tables, and the light fixture is flat enough still that it can be installed flush up near the ceiling revealing the beautiful, star-like pattern created by the fixture's arms.

item.title: Crown Modern Globe Flush Mount 46" Lighting Black | Dutton Brown
item.description: The Crown Globe Flush Mount 46" is our largest flush mount chandelier and forms a geometric pattern from its rods and nested vortex of globes. Handmade using exclusively designed solid brass parts, this fixture features 5 arms, each with two 8" globes branching in a Y-shape angled diagonally giving the fixture a captivating and dynamic view from every angle.

item.title: Color Lepore Modern Flush Mount Lighting White | Dutton Brown
item.description: The Color Lepore Flush Mount couples captivating color options with high-clarity acrylic to create a stunning flush mount light fixture. Available in variety of soft or bold colors, the disk can be customized to contain a picture, matching wall paper, or more.

item.title: Twink Modern Flush Mount Lighting Brass | Dutton Brown
item.description: Small. Cute. Surprisingly versatile. An industry first, you can finally own your very own Twink Flush Mount. Our Twink Flush Mount was designed to be small so that it fits just about anywhere, but with its uncompromising high-quality construction, it may well be the fiercest flush mount this small... ever. Made from high-gauge brass and aluminum (no flimsy parts here), and one of our 3 finishes, each Twink light makes no apologies for how cute it manages to be in every space. Compact and easy-to-install on whatever ceiling (or wall) is lucky enough to receive it, each Twink ensures all closets, hallways, bathrooms, and beyond get lit– because that's what Twinks do. Word to the wise. Maybe don't go searching for "Twinks" online elsewhere. You've been warned.

item.title: Color Cap Modern Globe Pendant 6" Lighting Black + Spa | Dutton Brown
item.description: Meet the Color Cap Pendant 6" – your colorful cure for the common cord set. This small but mighty globe pendant brings all the mid-century vibes with none of the nonsense. Carefully created in one of our 13 iconic colors and three finishes this pendant brings a new look to a timeless classic. Let it hang solo to brighten up a corner or in multiples for added drama. item.title: Twink Modern Flush Mount Lighting Black | Dutton Brown
item.description: Small. Cute. Surprisingly versatile. An industry first, you can finally own your very own Twink Flush Mount. Our Twink Flush Mount was designed to be small so that it fits just about anywhere, but with its uncompromising high-quality construction, it may well be the fiercest flush mount this small... ever. Made from high-gauge brass and aluminum (no flimsy parts here), and one of our 3 finishes, each Twink light makes no apologies for how cute it manages to be in every space. Compact and easy-to-install on whatever ceiling (or wall) is lucky enough to receive it, each Twink ensures all closets, hallways, bathrooms, and beyond get lit– because that's what Twinks do. Word to the wise. Maybe don't go searching for "Twinks" online elsewhere. You've been warned.

item.title: Color Eureka Modern Flush Mount Lighting Brass + White | Dutton Brown
item.description: Consider this your lighting ah-ha moment.The Color Eureka Flush Mount is here to prove that ceiling lighting should never be boring. With bold to classic color options, luxe finishes, and a clean, modern silhouette, Eureka will bring the “I’ve found it!” feeling to your next design project. Designed to light up desktops, dining tables, kitchen islands, and more, this fixture brings personality and polish wherever it goes. Pair it with the Color Eureka Pendant for a cohesive, color-forward look — or let it shine solo as a subtle but in space. With Eureka your search for the perfect lighting is over.

item.title: Color Cadbury Modern Pendant 8" Lighting Black + White | Dutton Brown
item.description: Our Color Cadbury Pendant 8" is the dome pendant born after we'd seen one too many tragically hung low-gauge dome pendants on crooked fabric cords. The solution? Cover the cord with a solid brass rod, integrate a seamless cap atop each dome, and source aluminum domes thick enough that they don't sound like flimsy cans when you tap them. Alike all our lighting, this pendant is basically a masterclass in how to do lighting design the right way. And with “Cadbury” meaning “strong fortress” in Celtic, this fixture is literally built on bold foundations. Pop a pair above your kitchen island or flank your vanity for a look that says, “Yes, I have great taste. Thanks for noticing.”

item.title: Color Bling Modern Pendant Lighting Brass + Spa | Dutton Brown
item.description: Our laser-cut acrylic Bling Pendant captures light in a way that must be seen to be believed. This fixture showcases our interpretation of modern minimalism via its two concentric high-clarity acrylic discs that catch the light just right. This sleek pendant light works solo to highlight a powder room, your makeup vanity, or in multiples to make a bold statement above your kitchen island, dining table, or down a dramatic runway (some call them hallways). No matter which color and finish you choose your ceilings are destined to shine. It’s the perfect finishing touch for spaces that crave a little glamour.

item.title: Color Reader Modern Pendant Lighting Brass + Spa | Dutton Brown
item.description: The library is open. Up first: Color Reader Pendant. Whether you need this pendant to light up the werkroom with multiples or just need one to illuminate your beauty corner, the Color Reader Pendant's tucked reflector-style bulb directs light downwards, eliminating distracting glare. Choose from 13 color options and 3 finishes to bring your space's story to life –– we suggest Orange and Nickel for our comedy queens or Barely and Brass for our pageant queens. Because reading is what? Fundamental.

item.description: Eureka - you've found it! A fixture designed to help you discover (if you didn't know already) that you're a minimalist. Whether you’re adding one for a focused glow or installing multiples for dramatic impact, Eureka was designed to help you discover your style... and your keys.

item.title: Color Echo Modern Pendant 8" Lighting Brass + Spa | Dutton Brown
item.description: The Color Echo Pendant 8" is so cute you'll hear compliments over and over almost like there's... an echo. With its bold, colorful dome and its inverted curved cap, this pendant brings playful energy and upbeat style to any space. Solid brass hardware and powder-coated finishes give it a luxurious edge, while its silhouette shows your space (and you) deserves something a bit more than basic dome shade lighting. So go ahead and hang one or keep the look going with doubles or triples because we believe good design deserves to be repeated – line up two or three above a kitchen island, bar, or vanity for lighting that resonates.

This globe chandelier features 5 arms, each with two 8" globes branching out in a Y-shape tilted diagonally giving the fixture a captivating view from every angle. Its circular shape is perfect above large circular and square tables, and the light fixture is flat enough still that it can be installed flush up near the ceiling revealing the beautiful, star-like pattern created by the fixture's arms.

item.title: Color Crown Modern Globe Chandelier 46" Lighting Brass + Barely | Dutton Brown
item.description: The Color Crown Globe Chandelier 46" is one of our largest chandeliers and is a structured beauty with its vortex of nested globes. This globe chandelier features 5 arms, each with two 8" globes branching out in a Y-shape tilted diagonally giving the fixture a captivating view from every angle. Its circular shape is perfect above large circular and square tables, and the light fixture is flat enough still that it can be installed flush up near the ceiling revealing the beautiful, star-like pattern created by the fixture's arms.

item.description: The Color Pose Flush Mount is a colorful alternative to track lighting. Each fixture is configured with adjustable swivel joints so that its arms so its light can be directed as you please. This colorful flush mount is designed to be compact and thus perfect to install in rooms with lower ceilings or high-swinging doors.

item.title: Color Twink Modern Wall Sconce Lighting Brass + Barely | Dutton Brown
item.description: Small but mighty, the Twink Sconce doesn't need to take up space to make a big impact.Crafted from high-gauge solid brass, this sconce installs just as easily on the wall as it does on the ceiling, so it's just as at home lighting a stairwell in multiples as it is standing alone above a hallway or entryway. Color your space with one of our powder coat options, then complete your Twink with brass, nickel, or black finishes. Proof that good things really do come in small packages.

item.title: Color Twink Modern Flush Mount Lighting Brass + Barely | Dutton Brown
item.description: Small. Cute. Surprisingly versatile. An industry first, you can finally own your very own Color Twink Flush Mount. Our Color Twink Flush Mount was designed to be small so that it fits just about anywhere, but with its uncompromising high-quality construction, it may well be the fiercest flush mount this small... ever. Made from high-gauge brass and aluminum (no flimsy parts here), and one of our 13 powder coat colors, each Twink light makes no apologies for how cute it manages to be in every space. Compact and easy-to-install on whatever ceiling (or wall) is lucky enough to receive it, each Twink ensures all closets, hallways, bathrooms, and beyond get lit– because that's what Twinks do. Word to the wise. Maybe don't go searching for "Twinks" online elsewhere. You've been warned.

item.title: Color Bling Modern Flush Mount Lighting Brass + Barely | Dutton Brown
item.description: The Color Bling Flush Mount and its acrylic disks create a captivating display of refracted light encircling the light fixture's rod all while perfectly sized to install in spaces with lower ceilings or where more head room is necessary. Install one in a small foyer to greet guests, or install two or three over a bar and add some modern style to your space.

item.title: Color Lepore Modern Flush Mount Lighting Barely | Dutton Brown
item.description: The Color Lepore Flush Mount couples captivating color options with high-clarity acrylic to create a stunning flush mount light fixture. This colorful fixture adds a "notice-me" touch to any space as its laser-cut crystal-clear acrylic structure refracts the light reflected on the colorful disk contained within its canopy. Available in variety of soft or bold colors, the disk can be customized to contain a picture, matching wall paper, or more.

item.title: Color Bling Modern Pendant Lighting Brass + Barely | Dutton Brown
item.description: Our laser-cut acrylic Bling Pendant captures light in a way that must be seen to be believed. This fixture showcases our interpretation of modern minimalism via its two concentric high-clarity acrylic discs that catch the light just right. This sleek pendant light works solo to highlight a powder room, your makeup vanity, or in multiples to make a bold statement above your kitchen island, dining table, or down a dramatic runway (some call them hallways). No matter which color and finish you choose your ceilings are destined to shine. It’s the perfect finishing touch for spaces that crave a little glamour.

item.title: Color Cadbury Modern Pendant 12" Lighting Brass + Barely | Dutton Brown
item.description: Our Color Cadbury Pendant 12" is the dome pendant born after we'd seen one too many tragically hung low-gauge dome pendants on crooked fabric cords. The solution? Cover the cord with a solid brass rod, integrate a seamless cap atop each dome, and source aluminum domes thick enough that they don't sound like empty soda cans when you tap them. Alike all our lighting, this pendant is basically a masterclass in how to do lighting the right way. And with “Cadbury” meaning “strong fortress” in Celtic, this fixture is literally built on bold foundations. Pop a pair above your kitchen island or flank your vanity for a look that says, “Yes, I have great taste. Thanks for noticing.”

item.title: Color Echo Modern Pendant 12" Lighting Brass + White | Dutton Brown
item.description: The Color Echo Pendant 12" is so cute you'll hear compliments over and over almost like there's... an echo. With its bold, colorful dome and its inverted curved cap, this pendant brings playful energy and upbeat style to any space. Solid brass hardware and powder-coated finishes give it a luxurious edge, while its silhouette shows your space (and you) deserves something a bit more than basic dome shade lighting. So go ahead and hang one or keep the look going with doubles or triples because we believe good design deserves to be repeated – line up two or three above a kitchen island, bar, or vanity for lighting that resonates.

item.title: Persona Pull Brass Hardware | Dutton Brown
item.description: Meet the Persona Pull — the very first hardware design we ever made, born from a simple idea: spaces have personas. Some have more than one. Each one is CNC-machined from solid brass and finished and assembled in our Minneapolis studio. The slim profile and three finish options mean it works as easily on a moody library cabinet as it does on a sunlit kitchen — line them across drawers, vanities, or pantries; mix finishes if your rooms have, well, range. You don't need multiple personalities to use multiple Personas. But they are convenient for those who do.

item.title: Color Legend 2 Modern Globe Wall Sconce Lighting Brass + White | Dutton Brown
item.description: They say legends are born, not made. We disagree. The Color Legend 2 Sconce is handcrafted right here in our Minneapolis studio — and it earned its name the old-fashioned way: by outselling everything else on the wall. Two hand-blown opal glass globes sit on a CNC-machined aluminum body with solid brass hardware, delivering soft, flattering light that looks as good off as it does on. A perfect choice above a powder room mirror or in pairs along an expansive bathroom vanity scene. Choose from our variety of powder coat colors and 3 finishes to make it yours — and then tie your space together with some of our color-coordinated hardware. All this Legend's waiting for is a Legend like you to give it a home.

item.title: Caliber Pull Brass Hardware | Dutton Brown
item.description: Meet the Caliber Pull — a solid brass cabinet pull destined for spaces and furniture that are themselves also high caliber. Or that will be, once you pair them with these dense, cylindrical baubles. Each one is CNC-machined from solid brass and finished and assembled in our Minneapolis studio by an artisan who is, you guessed it, high caliber. The pull mixes round parts with defined edges to deliver an impactful silhouette — its concentric ring arms couple with a dense, weighted feel atop cabinets, drawers, and pantries alike. Not everything high caliber goes boom. Some things high caliber go "wow."

Not everything high caliber goes boom. Some things high caliber go "wow."

item.title: Color Pilot Modern Wall Sconce 11" Lighting Brass + White | Dutton Brown
item.description: Reporting for duty: Color Pilot Sconce 11". Crafted from CNC-machined aluminum and brass, the Color Pilot Sconce 11" installs close to the wall, so it fits into tight spots other fixtures can't touch, think vanity lighting, above bathroom mirrors, hallways, and foyers. item.title: Persona Pull Nickel Hardware | Dutton Brown
item.description: Meet the Persona Pull — the very first hardware design we ever made, born from a simple idea: spaces have personas. Some have more than one. Each one is CNC-machined from solid brass and finished and assembled in our Minneapolis studio. The slim profile and three finish options mean it works as easily on a moody library cabinet as it does on a sunlit kitchen — line them across drawers, vanities, or pantries; mix finishes if your rooms have, well, range. You don't need multiple personalities to use multiple Personas. But they are convenient for those who do.

item.title: Caliber Pull Nickel Hardware | Dutton Brown
item.description: Meet the Caliber Pull — a solid brass cabinet pull destined for spaces and furniture that are themselves also high caliber. Or that will be, once you pair them with these dense, cylindrical baubles. Each one is CNC-machined from solid brass and finished and assembled in our Minneapolis studio by an artisan who is, you guessed it, high caliber. item.title: Color Twink Modern Flush Mount Lighting Brass + Bone | Dutton Brown
item.description: Small. Cute. Surprisingly versatile. An industry first, you can finally own your very own Color Twink Flush Mount. Our Color Twink Flush Mount was designed to be small so that it fits just about anywhere, but with its uncompromising high-quality construction, it may well be the fiercest flush mount this small... ever. Made from high-gauge brass and aluminum (no flimsy parts here), and one of our 13 powder coat colors, each Twink light makes no apologies for how cute it manages to be in every space. Compact and easy-to-install on whatever ceiling (or wall) is lucky enough to receive it, each Twink ensures all closets, hallways, bathrooms, and beyond get lit– because that's what Twinks do. Word to the wise. Maybe don't go searching for "Twinks" online elsewhere. You've been warned.

item.title: Color Cadbury Modern Pendant 8" Lighting Brass + Bone | Dutton Brown
item.description: Our Color Cadbury Pendant 8" is the dome pendant born after we'd seen one too many tragically hung low-gauge dome pendants on crooked fabric cords. The solution? Cover the cord with a solid brass rod, integrate a seamless cap atop each dome, and source aluminum domes thick enough that they don't sound like flimsy cans when you tap them. Alike all our lighting, this pendant is basically a masterclass in how to do lighting design the right way. And with “Cadbury” meaning “strong fortress” in Celtic, this fixture is literally built on bold foundations. Pop a pair above your kitchen island or flank your vanity for a look that says, “Yes, I have great taste. Thanks for noticing.”

item.title: Color Echo Modern Pendant 8" Lighting Brass + Bone | Dutton Brown
item.description: The Color Echo Pendant 8" is so cute you'll hear compliments over and over almost like there's... an echo. With its bold, colorful dome and its inverted curved cap, this pendant brings playful energy and upbeat style to any space. Solid brass hardware and powder-coated finishes give it a luxurious edge, while its silhouette shows your space (and you) deserves something a bit more than basic dome shade lighting. So go ahead and hang one or keep the look going with doubles or triples because we believe good design deserves to be repeated – line up two or three above a kitchen island, bar, or vanity for lighting that resonates.

item.title: Color Bling Modern Pendant Lighting Brass + Bone | Dutton Brown
item.description: Our laser-cut acrylic Bling Pendant captures light in a way that must be seen to be believed. This fixture showcases our interpretation of modern minimalism via its two concentric high-clarity acrylic discs that catch the light just right. This sleek pendant light works solo to highlight a powder room, your makeup vanity, or in multiples to make a bold statement above your kitchen island, dining table, or down a dramatic runway (some call them hallways). No matter which color and finish you choose your ceilings are destined to shine. It’s the perfect finishing touch for spaces that crave a little glamour.

item.title: Color Pilot Modern Pendant 29" Lighting Bone | Dutton Brown
item.description: Ready for takeoff? The Color Pilot Pendant 29" is here to bring bold, yet playful energy to your space. With its simple, T-shaped silhouette and with the choice of one of our 13 powder-coated finishes, this modern pendant light keeps things streamlined but far from boring. Two exposed bulbs stretch across a clean aluminum arm, creating a crisp line of light that feels fresh and fun. Perfect for long kitchen islands, dining tables, and hallways, this pendant will bring your spaces lighting to new heights. Whether you're an interior design frequent flyer, or a new passenger to the lighting world, Pilot is here to steer your lighting in the right direction. With this fixture you can bet on there being no turbulence, just smooth, effortless design.

item.title: Color Legend 3 Modern Globe Wall Sconce Lighting Brass + Bone | Dutton Brown
item.description: If you want your space to tell your story, then why not make it a Legend? The Color Legend 3 Sconce takes everything that made our Legend 2 a bestseller and just gives you more of it — an extra 7 inches for you size queens out there... and an extra ball. Three hand-blown opal glass globes line a CNC-machined aluminum body with solid brass hardware, casting soft, even light in a form that looks as good off as it does on. Its longer profile was built for wide vanities, more expansive mirrors, and any bathroom scene ready for a colorful Dutton Brown moment. Choose from our variety of powder coat colors and 3 finishes to make it yours. What type of Legend will your space tell about you? They say legends are born, not made. We disagree. The Color Legend 3 Sconce is handcrafted right here in our Minneapolis studio — and it earned its name the old-fashioned way: by outselling everything else on the wall. Two hand-blown opal glass globes sit on a CNC-machined aluminum body with solid brass hardware, delivering soft, flattering light that looks as good off as it does on. A perfect choice above a powder room mirror or in pairs along an expansive bathroom vanity scene. Sharing a name with our Legend 2 Sconce, but with an extra 7 inches for you size queens out there... and an extra ball. Choose from our variety of powder coat colors and 3 finishes to make it yours — and then tie your space together with some of our color-coordinated hardware. All this Legend's waiting for is a Legend like you to give it a home.

item.title: Color Persona Pull - Black Black Bone Hardware | Dutton Brown
item.description: Meet the Persona Pull — the very first hardware design we ever made, born from a simple idea: spaces have personas. Some have more than one. Each one is CNC-machined from solid brass and powder-coated in one of our 14 signature colors, then finished and assembled in our Minneapolis studio. The slim profile and three finish options mean it works as easily on a moody library cabinet as it does on a sunlit kitchen — line them across drawers, vanities, or pantries; mix finishes if your rooms have, well, range. You don't need multiple personalities to use multiple Personas. But they are convenient for those who do.

item.title: Color Caliber Pull - Nickel Nickel Bone Hardware | Dutton Brown
item.description: Meet the Caliber Pull — a solid brass cabinet pull destined for spaces and furniture that are themselves also high caliber. Or that will be, once you pair them with these dense, cylindrical baubles. Each one is CNC-machined from solid brass and powder-coated in one of our 14 signature colors, then finished and assembled in our Minneapolis studio by an artisan who is, you guessed it, high caliber. The pull mixes round parts with defined edges to deliver an impactful silhouette — its concentric ring arms couple with a dense, weighted feel atop cabinets, drawers, and pantries alike. Not everything high caliber goes boom. Some things high caliber go "wow."

item.title: Color Twink Modern Pendant Lighting Nickel + White | Dutton Brown
item.description: Meet Twink – proof that size doesn’t matter (most of the time). This minimalist pendant light pairs its simple silhouette with CNC-machined edges for a modern yet fun-loving vibe, perfect for personalizing any space. Good in every room, use this pendant light to accent a reading nook, or install multiple to illuminate a kitchen island, or breakfast bar. Handcrafted from high-quality solid brass and aluminum and assembled in your choice of brass, nickel, or black finishes. Twink proves that sometimes the great things come in small packages, and we have no doubt you'll love the view of one (or many) of our well-hung Twinks.

item.title: Color Caliber Pull - Brass Brass Chalk Hardware | Dutton Brown
item.description: Meet the Caliber Pull — a solid brass cabinet pull destined for spaces and furniture that are themselves also high caliber. Or that will be, once you pair them with these dense, cylindrical baubles. Each one is CNC-machined from solid brass and powder-coated in one of our 14 signature colors, then finished and assembled in our Minneapolis studio by an artisan who is, you guessed it, high caliber. The pull mixes round parts with defined edges to deliver an impactful silhouette — its concentric ring arms couple with a dense, weighted feel atop cabinets, drawers, and pantries alike. Not everything high caliber goes boom. Some things high caliber go "wow."

item.title: Color Pilot Modern Pendant 29" Lighting Chalk | Dutton Brown
item.description: Ready for takeoff? The Color Pilot Pendant 29" is here to bring bold, yet playful energy to your space. With its simple, T-shaped silhouette and with the choice of one of our 13 powder-coated finishes, this modern pendant light keeps things streamlined but far from boring. Two exposed bulbs stretch across a clean aluminum arm, creating a crisp line of light that feels fresh and fun. Perfect for long kitchen islands, dining tables, and hallways, this pendant will bring your spaces lighting to new heights. Whether you're an interior design frequent flyer, or a new passenger to the lighting world, Pilot is here to steer your lighting in the right direction. With this fixture you can bet on there being no turbulence, just smooth, effortless design.

item.title: Color Twink Modern Pendant Lighting Brass + Chalk | Dutton Brown
item.description: Meet Twink – proof that size doesn’t matter (most of the time). This minimalist pendant light pairs its simple silhouette with CNC-machined edges for a modern yet fun-loving vibe, perfect for personalizing any space. Good in every room, use this pendant light to accent a reading nook, or install multiple to illuminate a kitchen island, or breakfast bar. Handcrafted from high-quality solid brass and aluminum and assembled in your choice of brass, nickel, or black finishes. Twink proves that sometimes the great things come in small packages, and we have no doubt you'll love the view of one (or many) of our well-hung Twinks.

item.title: Color Reader Modern Pendant Lighting Brass + Chalk | Dutton Brown
item.description: The library is open. Up first: Color Reader Pendant. Whether you need this pendant to light up the werkroom with multiples or just need one to illuminate your beauty corner, the Color Reader Pendant's tucked reflector-style bulb directs light downwards, eliminating distracting glare. Choose from 13 color options and 3 finishes to bring your space's story to life –– we suggest Orange and Nickel for our comedy queens or Barely and Brass for our pageant queens. Because reading is what? Fundamental.

item.title: Color Eureka Modern Pendant Lighting Brass + Chalk | Dutton Brown
item.description: Eureka - you've found it! A fixture designed to help you discover (if you didn't know already) that you're a minimalist. The Color Eureka Pendant is the light your space has been waiting for. Combining modern minimalist design with customizable style, this cute fixture creates that joyous “aha moment” every time you flip the switch. Handcrafted from high-quality materials, this ceiling pendant offers permanence that corded drop lights can only dream of. No flimsy wires here. Choose from 13 powder-coated color options to match your kitchen island countertops, dining room wallpaper, or inside a walk-in closet. Whether you’re adding one for a focused glow or installing multiples for dramatic impact, Eureka was designed to help you discover your style... and your keys.

item.title: Color Cadbury Modern Pendant 8" Lighting Brass + Chalk | Dutton Brown
item.description: Our Color Cadbury Pendant 8" is the dome pendant born after we'd seen one too many tragically hung low-gauge dome pendants on crooked fabric cords. The solution? Cover the cord with a solid brass rod, integrate a seamless cap atop each dome, and source aluminum domes thick enough that they don't sound like flimsy cans when you tap them. Alike all our lighting, this pendant is basically a masterclass in how to do lighting design the right way. And with “Cadbury” meaning “strong fortress” in Celtic, this fixture is literally built on bold foundations. Pop a pair above your kitchen island or flank your vanity for a look that says, “Yes, I have great taste. Thanks for noticing.”

item.title: Color Cadbury Modern Pendant 10" Lighting Brass + Chalk | Dutton Brown
item.description: Our Color Cadbury Pendant 10" is the dome pendant born after we'd seen one too many tragically hung low-gauge dome pendants on crooked fabric cords. The solution? Cover the cord with a solid brass rod, integrate a seamless cap atop each dome, and source aluminum domes thick enough that they don't sound like empty soda cans when you tap them. item.title: Color Caliber Pull - Black Black Chalk Hardware | Dutton Brown

Each one is CNC-machined from solid brass and powder-coated in one of our 14 signature colors, then finished and assembled in our Minneapolis studio by an artisan who is, you guessed it, high caliber. Not everything high caliber goes boom. Some things high caliber go "wow."

item.title: Color Axia Modern Globe Chandelier Lighting Brass + White | Dutton Brown
item.description: The Color Axia Globe Chandelier is a linear statement light fixture that offers a midcentury nod to contemporary lighting design. The design combines sharp CNC-machined edges with high-end aluminum and brass parts. The result is a linear showstopper that can be personalized by color and finish in the form of a stunning horizontal silhouette. This chandelier features 6-inch hand-blown glass globes and is also available in a larger "Big Axia" version featuring 8-inch globes. Both sizes are designed proportionally to install above long dining tables and kitchen islands, but the designs are versatile enough to impress in a variety of situations.

This horizontal bauble offers a midcentury nod to contemporary lighting design that was conceived with the goal of smacking gobs and inspiring jealou.... erm... envy. The design combines sharp CNC-machined edges with high-end aluminum and brass parts. The result is a linear showstopper that can be personalized by color and finish.This chandelier features 8-inch hand-blown glass globes and is also available in a slimmer version featuring 6-inch globes. Both sizes are designed proportionally to install above long dining tables, kitchen islands, and any situation in need of something fierce.

item.title: Color Maxo Modern Flush Mount 13" Lighting Brass + White | Dutton Brown
item.description: The Color Maxo Flush Mount 13" was designed to create a statement, snug-to-the-ceiling silhouette perfect for high-end personalization. The fixture combines colorful CNC-machined aluminum parts with metallic details to create an elevated lighting option. The fixture features a unique, filleted-edge matte glass drum shade perfect for diffused general lighting. The fixture is built with an UNO thread, so if you ever decided you wanted another shade, then you can easily swap it out. It's a great lighting option in low foyers, low hallways, low closets, and above high swinging doors.

item.title: Color Vogue 7 Modern Wall Sconce Lighting Brass + White | Dutton Brown
item.description: The Color Vogue 7 Sconce is a contemporary interpretation of the oft-seen linear multi-bulb vanity light running the perimeter of a mirror. Our largest wall sconce design, this fixture serves sharp CNC-machined aluminum edges in a linear shape perfect for getting the most out of a single junction box in bathrooms, above vanities, over mirrors, and more. Its 7-bulb arrangement is designed to create a linear column of light that distributes light widely and evenly. The base of the fixture remains minimal while the colorful options lend the fixture to be well-suited to a variety of color schemes.

item.title: Color Swift Knob Brass White Hardware | Dutton Brown
item.description: Meet the Swift Knob — this T-shaped cabinet knob is part of our fastest-selling Swift collection. Maybe there's something about the name. Or maybe it's just really cute? Either way, folks love how this chunky yet defined CNC-machined aluminum rod (available in 14 powder coat colors) perches atop a solid brass arm in 3 finishes. What's more fun is that each one is finished and assembled in our Minneapolis studio before being sent off to its perfect home — alongside our Swift Pulls on kitchen cabinets, bathroom vanities, or an heirloom dresser. Honestly, we never really have to try to sell anyone on these. With the way they sell out, there's no more perfect name than Swift.

What's more fun is that each one is finished and assembled in our Minneapolis studio before being sent off to its perfect home — alongside our Swift Pulls on kitchen cabinets, bathroom vanities, or an heirloom dresser. Honestly, we never really have to try to sell anyone on these. With the way they sell out, there's no more perfect name than Swift.

No matter which color and finish you choose your ceilings are destined to shine. It’s the perfect finishing touch for spaces that crave a little glamour.

item.description: Meet the Color Cap Pendant 8" – your colorful cure for the common cord set. Carefully created in one of our 13 iconic colors and three finishes this pendant brings a new look to a timeless classic. Let it hang solo to brighten up a corner or in multiples for added drama. Line it in kitchens, hallways, bathrooms, and any space in need of soft, flattering light. Because every room deserves a glow-up.

Its CNC-machined aluminum parts come in 13 different powder-coated colors accented by brass, nickel, or black finishes, making it the ultimate way to inject personality into your space (because basic is boring). And thanks to its clever UNO-threaded attachment, you can swap out the shade whenever your design mood changes – not that you’d ever want to part ways with this beauty. Hang it as kitchen island lighting for an instant upgrade, install it in your foyer to flex your aesthetic the moment guests walk in, or line a hallway, closet, or bedside setup for maximum modern impact.

item.title: Color Cadbury Modern Pendant 10" Lighting Brass + Pinkaboo | Dutton Brown
item.description: Our Color Cadbury Pendant 10" is the dome pendant born after we'd seen one too many tragically hung low-gauge dome pendants on crooked fabric cords. The solution? Cover the cord with a solid brass rod, integrate a seamless cap atop each dome, and source aluminum domes thick enough that they don't sound like empty soda cans when you tap them. Alike all our lighting, this pendant is basically a masterclass in how to do lighting the right way. And with “Cadbury” meaning “strong fortress” in Celtic, this fixture is literally built on bold foundations. Pop a pair above your kitchen island or flank your vanity for a look that says, “Yes, I have great taste. Thanks for noticing.”

item.description: Our Color Cadbury Pendant 10" is the dome pendant born after we'd seen one too many tragically hung low-gauge dome pendants on crooked fabric cords. The solution? Cover the cord with a solid brass rod, integrate a seamless cap atop each dome, and source aluminum domes thick enough that they don't sound like empty soda cans when you tap them. Alike all our lighting, this pendant is basically a masterclass in how to do lighting the right way. And with “Cadbury” meaning “strong fortress” in Celtic, this fixture is literally built on bold foundations. Pop a pair above your kitchen island or flank your vanity for a look that says, “Yes, I have great taste. Thanks for noticing.”

item.title: Color Caliber Pull - Black Black Pinkaboo Hardware | Dutton Brown
item.description: Meet the Caliber Pull — a solid brass cabinet pull destined for spaces and furniture that are themselves also high caliber. Or that will be, once you pair them with these dense, cylindrical baubles. Each one is CNC-machined from solid brass and powder-coated in one of our 14 signature colors, then finished and assembled in our Minneapolis studio by an artisan who is, you guessed it, high caliber. The pull mixes round parts with defined edges to deliver an impactful silhouette — its concentric ring arms couple with a dense, weighted feel atop cabinets, drawers, and pantries alike. Not everything high caliber goes boom. Some things high caliber go "wow."

item.title: Color Cap Modern Globe Pendant 10" Lighting Brass + Pinkaboo | Dutton Brown
item.description: Meet the Color Cap Pendant 10" – your colorful cure for the common cord set. This modern take on an iconic globe style pendant brings all the mid-century vibes with none of the nonsense. Its hand-blown opal glass and solid brass construction give it a luxe feel, while the solid rod mount keeps it looking sharp and secure (no flimsy, floppy cords here). Carefully created in one of our 13 iconic colors and three finishes this pendant brings a new look to a timeless classic. Let it hang solo to brighten up a corner or in multiples for added drama. Line it in kitchens, hallways, bathrooms, and any space in need of soft, flattering light. Because every room deserves a glow-up.

item.description: The Color Maxo Flush Mount 13" was designed to create a statement, snug-to-the-ceiling silhouette perfect for high-end personalization. The fixture combines colorful CNC-machined aluminum parts with metallic details to create an elevated lighting option. The fixture features a unique, filleted-edge matte glass drum shade perfect for diffused general lighting. The fixture is built with an UNO thread, so if you ever decided you wanted another shade, then you can easily swap it out. It's a great lighting option in low foyers, low hallways, low closets, and above high swinging doors.

item.title: Color Persona Pull - Black Black Pinkaboo Hardware | Dutton Brown
item.description: Meet the Persona Pull — the very first hardware design we ever made, born from a simple idea: spaces have personas. Some have more than one. Each one is CNC-machined from solid brass and powder-coated in one of our 14 signature colors, then finished and assembled in our Minneapolis studio. The slim profile and three finish options mean it works as easily on a moody library cabinet as it does on a sunlit kitchen — line them across drawers, vanities, or pantries; mix finishes if your rooms have, well, range. You don't need multiple personalities to use multiple Personas. But they are convenient for those who do.

A solid aluminum rod rides on two CNC-machined brass arms, powder-coated in one of our 14 signature colors and made to order in our Minneapolis studio. Line them across kitchen cabinets, bathroom vanities, or a dresser; with five sizes from 5″ to 14″, there's an option for every size queen. Suffice to say it's easy to understand how this Swift pull earned a… reputation.

item.title: Color Twink Modern Flush Mount Lighting Brass + Pinkaboo | Dutton Brown
item.description: Small. Cute. Surprisingly versatile. An industry first, you can finally own your very own Color Twink Flush Mount. Our Color Twink Flush Mount was designed to be small so that it fits just about anywhere, but with its uncompromising high-quality construction, it may well be the fiercest flush mount this small... ever. Made from high-gauge brass and aluminum (no flimsy parts here), and one of our 13 powder coat colors, each Twink light makes no apologies for how cute it manages to be in every space. Compact and easy-to-install on whatever ceiling (or wall) is lucky enough to receive it, each Twink ensures all closets, hallways, bathrooms, and beyond get lit– because that's what Twinks do. Word to the wise. Maybe don't go searching for "Twinks" online elsewhere. You've been warned.

item.title: Color Twink Modern Pendant Lighting Brass + Pinkaboo | Dutton Brown
item.description: Meet Twink – proof that size doesn’t matter (most of the time). This minimalist pendant light pairs its simple silhouette with CNC-machined edges for a modern yet fun-loving vibe, perfect for personalizing any space. Good in every room, use this pendant light to accent a reading nook, or install multiple to illuminate a kitchen island, or breakfast bar. Handcrafted from high-quality solid brass and aluminum and assembled in your choice of brass, nickel, or black finishes. Twink proves that sometimes the great things come in small packages, and we have no doubt you'll love the view of one (or many) of our well-hung Twinks.

item.title: Color Maxo Modern Pendant 13" Lighting Brass + Pinkaboo | Dutton Brown
item.description: Designed to the Maxo. The Color Maxo Pendant 13" is a high-gauge aluminum two-rod light fixture is so solid that we recommend you hang it, so you don't bump your head because if you do... our money's on the Maxo. Featuring parallel solid aluminum extension rods gives your space an expert-level architectural vibe that lives for strength and style. Its CNC-machined aluminum parts come in 13 different powder-coated colors accented by brass, nickel, or black finishes, making it the ultimate way to inject personality into your space (because basic is boring). With its filleted-edge matte glass drum shade it diffuses light evenly, making every moment of your day shine brighter. And thanks to its clever UNO-threaded attachment, you can swap out the shade whenever your design mood changes – not that you’d ever want to part ways with this beauty. Hang it as kitchen island lighting for an instant upgrade, install it in your foyer to flex your aesthetic the moment guests walk in, or line a hallway, closet, or bedside setup for maximum modern impact.

Alike all our lighting, this pendant is basically a masterclass in how to do lighting the right way. And with “Cadbury” meaning “strong fortress” in Celtic, this fixture is literally built on bold foundations. Pop a pair above your kitchen island or flank your vanity for a look that says, “Yes, I have great taste. Thanks for noticing.”

Each chandelier is carefully assembled by adorning a CNC-machined aluminum core with 316 individually threaded solid brass rods. What makes this fixture special though are its 124 colorful beads, all powder coated here in-house, that create an explosive supernova effect. Choose from our array of colors or a custom color and learn why our customers oft call this "my urchin".

item.title: Color Echo Modern Pendant 8" Lighting Brass + White | Dutton Brown
item.description: The Color Echo Pendant 8" is so cute you'll hear compliments over and over almost like there's... an echo. With its bold, colorful dome and its inverted curved cap, this pendant brings playful energy and upbeat style to any space. Solid brass hardware and powder-coated finishes give it a luxurious edge, while its silhouette shows your space (and you) deserves something a bit more than basic dome shade lighting. So go ahead and hang one or keep the look going with doubles or triples because we believe good design deserves to be repeated – line up two or three above a kitchen island, bar, or vanity for lighting that resonates.

This fixture showcases our interpretation of modern minimalism via its two concentric high-clarity acrylic discs that catch the light just right. This sleek pendant light works solo to highlight a powder room, your makeup vanity, or in multiples to make a bold statement above your kitchen island, dining table, or down a dramatic runway (some call them hallways). No matter which color and finish you choose your ceilings are destined to shine. It’s the perfect finishing touch for spaces that crave a little glamour.

item.title: Color Twink Modern Pendant Lighting Brass + White | Dutton Brown
item.description: Meet Twink – proof that size doesn’t matter (most of the time). This minimalist pendant light pairs its simple silhouette with CNC-machined edges for a modern yet fun-loving vibe, perfect for personalizing any space. Good in every room, use this pendant light to accent a reading nook, or install multiple to illuminate a kitchen island, or breakfast bar. Handcrafted from high-quality solid brass and aluminum and assembled in your choice of brass, nickel, or black finishes. Twink proves that sometimes the great things come in small packages, and we have no doubt you'll love the view of one (or many) of our well-hung Twinks.

item.title: Color Eureka Modern Pendant Lighting Brass + White | Dutton Brown
item.description: Eureka - you've found it! A fixture designed to help you discover (if you didn't know already) that you're a minimalist. Handcrafted from high-quality materials, this ceiling pendant offers permanence that corded drop lights can only dream of. No flimsy wires here. Choose from 13 powder-coated color options to match your kitchen island countertops, dining room wallpaper, or inside a walk-in closet. Whether you’re adding one for a focused glow or installing multiples for dramatic impact, Eureka was designed to help you discover your style... and your keys.

item.title: Cap Modern Globe Pendant 12" Lighting Brass | Dutton Brown
item.description: Meet the Cap Pendant 12" – your high-end cure for the common cord set. This modern take on an iconic globe style pendant brings all the mid-century vibes with none of the nonsense. Its hand-blown opal glass and solid brass construction give it a luxe feel, while the solid rod mount keeps it looking sharp and secure (no flimsy, floppy cords here). Let it hang solo to brighten up a corner or in multiples for added drama. Line it in kitchens, hallways, bathrooms, and any space in need of soft, flattering light. Because every room deserves a glow-up.

item.title: Crown Modern Globe Chandelier 46" Lighting Brass | Dutton Brown
item.description: The Crown Globe Chandelier 46" is one of our largest chandeliers and is a structured beauty with its vortex of nested globes. This globe chandelier features 5 arms, each with two 8" globes branching out in a Y-shape tilted diagonally giving the fixture a captivating view from every angle. Its circular shape is perfect above large circular and square tables, and the light fixture is flat enough still that it can be installed flush up near the ceiling revealing the beautiful, star-like pattern created by the fixture's arms.

item.title: Color Pilot Modern Pendant 47" Lighting Black | Dutton Brown
item.description: Ready for takeoff? The Color Pilot Pendant 47" is here to bring bold, yet playful energy to your space. With its simple, T-shaped silhouette and with the choice of one of our 13 powder-coated finishes, this modern pendant light keeps things streamlined but far from boring. Two exposed bulbs stretch across a clean aluminum arm, creating a crisp line of light that feels fresh and fun. Perfect for long kitchen islands, dining tables, and hallways, this pendant will bring your spaces lighting to new heights. Whether you're an interior design frequent flyer, or a new passenger to the lighting world, Pilot is here to steer your lighting in the right direction. With this fixture you can bet on there being no turbulence, just smooth, effortless design.

item.title: LED G25 Bulb - Matte White Lighting | Dutton Brown
item.description: This globular LED bulb is as attractive as it is energy efficient. Encased in high-quality matte white glass with no chunky exposed base, the bulb is a Dutton Brown exclusive designed in a ubiquitous G25 globe silhouette. The bulb's neck has been shortened slightly to help the bulb sit closer to the socket than off the shelf variants with longer necks that stick out further from a fixture. The bulb is ideal for indoor spaces and is designed for use with exposed sockets.

item.title: LED T45 Bulb - Matte White Lighting | Dutton Brown
item.description: This tubular shape LED bulb is as attractive as it is energy efficient. Encased in high-quality matte white glass with no chunky exposed base, the bulb is a Dutton Brown exclusive designed with a diameter that matches the size of our light fixtures lamp cups to create a seamless, integrated look. The bulb's length has also been increased to increase the bulb's surface area creating a softer diffusion of the light to help reduce "floaters" characteristic of smaller, bright bulbs. The bulb is ideal for indoor spaces and is designed for use with exposed sockets.
